copy collage generator parameters including patch indices and transformers between population members
load a patch file from a URL or repo path and return segmented image data with alpha masks
generate low and high resolution patch data for a collage from a config dict and index
add a binary alpha mask to an RGB patch where black pixels have alpha zero
resize an image patch by a given coefficient using cv2 resize
normalize patch brightness by dividing by max intensity and scaling to 255
render RGB image patches with transparency using black as the transparent colour

render RGB image patches by overlaying them on top of one another using softmax-weighted order
render RGB image patches with an optional background image tensor added to the output
render RGB image patches with inverted colours by passing the invert_colours flag
run a single optimization step with CLIP encoding, gradient backpropagation, and learning rate annealing
run a genetic algorithm evolution step using microbial competition or evolutionary strategies on the population
run an evaluation step to compute cosine similarity losses between generated images and CLIP text features

create an SGD optimizer with separate learning rates for base parameters and position parameters

build a PopulationColourRGBTransforms module to apply red, green, and blue color transforms to image patches

refactor the copy_and_mutate_s method to mutate transform parameters from parent to child with configurable mutation scales
